name: CodeBuddy Tencent Cloud CodeBuddy
title: CodeBuddy · Personal trial
why: The official personal experience plan is priced at ¥0 and includes a monthly credit allowance plus code completion. It is a tool subscription, not an unrestricted API key.
command: Download the CodeBuddy IDE from the official product page.
renewal: No paid renewal for the listed personal plan
evidence: Official personal experience plan is priced at ¥0 with monthly credits and code completion.
notes: A free IDE plan is not an unrestricted API key.

name: Qoder AI coding IDE
title: Qoder · Experience plan
why: New users can receive a one-time 14-day Pro trial with 300 credits. The free experience plan continues with basic-model messages after the trial.
command: Download Qoder from the official site, then sign in to claim the trial.
renewal: Trial terms may change; check the official account page
evidence: Official pricing documentation describes a free experience plan and one-time 14-day Pro trial with 300 credits.
notes: Trial and renewal conditions can change.

name: TRAE TraeCode China AI IDE
freeSummary: Personal version is free; quota varies by mode
title: TraeCode CN · Personal plan
why: The official China pricing page lists the personal plan at ¥0. Exact quota depends on the product mode and current operating rules, so the directory intentionally avoids inventing a fixed token number.
command: Open the official download center and choose your Windows or macOS installer.
renewal: No paid renewal stated for the personal plan
evidence: Official China pricing page lists the personal version at ¥0; exact mode quota is not fixed in this directory.
notes: Do not turn a mode-dependent quota into a fixed token claim.

name: Baidu Comate AI coding assistant
freeSummary: 150k tokens / hour in free fallback mode
title: Baidu Comate · Auto-Free mode
why: The official pricing page lists a free Auto-Free fallback mode. It is designed to continue serving after model quota is unavailable, with a separate hourly limit.
validity: Ongoing while the free mode is offered
command: Install the standalone IDE or the VS Code / JetBrains extension from the official page.
renewal: Free fallback mode is subject to provider rules
evidence: Official pricing page lists a free Auto-Free fallback mode with a separate hourly token limit.
notes: Auto-Free is a product mode, not an unrestricted API quota.

name: Doubao Seed Code Coding Plan
title: Doubao Seed Code · Coding Plan Lite
why: This is a first-month promotion, not a free plan. The renewal price is shown next to the promotional price so overseas users do not mistake it for permanent access.
command: Configure the official coding endpoint in your supported coding tool after subscribing.
quota: Coding Plan Lite; first month promotional price
evidence: Official Volcengine announcement describes the first-month price and renewal price.
notes: This is a paid promotion, not a free plan.

name: GLM Coding Plan Zhipu
freeSummary: Quota multiplier changes by provider time
title: GLM Coding Plan
why: The official FAQ documents time-dependent quota consumption. The product converts the provider’s UTC+8 window into the visitor’s local time rather than claiming that every midnight is cheaper.
command: Use the dedicated coding endpoint in Claude Code, Cursor, Cline or another supported tool.
timeWindow: Provider peak: 14:00–18:00 UTC+8. Use the remaining window for the lower multiplier; the exact promotion can change.
renewal: Plan and time windows are provider-controlled
evidence: Official FAQ documents peak and non-peak quota consumption by provider time.
notes: Never describe this as a universal local-midnight discount.

name: LongCat Meituan API
freeSummary: Official API exists; no free quota confirmed
title: LongCat API · status check
why: LongCat has a public API platform and supports non-mainland email or phone login. The official docs confirm API access but do not confirm a free quota, so it stays out of the free list.
mechanism: Paid API status; free quota not confirmed
evidence: Official docs confirm the API platform but do not confirm a durable free quota.
notes: Do not promote as free without a public quota rule.

name: LongCat 2.0 Meituan open weights
freeSummary: Weights are free; compute is not
title: LongCat-2.0 · open weights
why: The official repository links the model for local deployment. “Free” means the weights are available; a 1.6T-parameter model still requires serious GPU or hosted infrastructure.
command:
python -m pip install -U huggingface_hub
huggingface-cli download meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.0 --local-dir ./LongCat-2.0
commercialUse: check MIT and model card terms
evidence: Official repository links the model for local deployment and documents the license.
notes: Weights free does not mean GPU, storage or inference free.

name: Qwen3 4B Alibaba open weights
title: Qwen3-4B · open weights
why: The official Hugging Face model card provides a direct model repository. This is a more realistic local starting point than trillion-parameter models for a developer laptop or a small cloud GPU.
command:
python -m pip install -U huggingface_hub
huggingface-cli download Qwen/Qwen3-4B --local-dir ./Qwen3-4B
evidence: Official Hugging Face model card provides the model repository and download path.
notes: Local inference still needs compatible hardware or hosted compute.

name: GLM 4.7 Flash Zhipu open weights
title: GLM-4.7-Flash · open weights
why: The official Zhipu repository lists GLM-4.7-Flash download links for Hugging Face and ModelScope. The page surfaces both because international users often have better access to Hugging Face.
command:
python -m pip install -U huggingface_hub
huggingface-cli download zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash --local-dir ./GLM-4.7-Flash
evidence: Official Zhipu repository and model card provide Hugging Face and ModelScope download paths.
notes: Verify the exact license on the current model card before commercial use.

title: SenseNova · free status pending
why: SenseTime’s official documentation confirms the Model-as-a-Service API and experience center. A public, durable free-quota rule was not confirmed, so the directory keeps it visible but does not call it free.
mechanism: API / experience center; free quota pending

evidence: Official documentation confirms the API and experience center but not a durable public free quota.
notes: Keep visible for discovery but do not label as free until confirmed.

name: DeepSeek API official

title: DeepSeek API · low cost, not free
